_comment: grade must be one of rules.json fableGrades, in ascending order of rarity: Historical, Legendary, Quasi-Mythical, Mythical, Giant.

fables.name: The First Ledger
fables.description: Recognition for having kept a record no one else thought to keep.
fables.story: Long before anyone else thought to write it down, this character kept count of names, debts, and warnings that later mattered a great deal.
fables.requirements: Complete a scenario by relying on notes taken during a previous one.
fables.dateObtainedNote: Set automatically when a Dungeon Master awards this Fable.

fables.name: Unbroken Line
fables.description: Held a line that should not have held.
fables.story: Everyone else fell back. This character did not, and the line did not break because of it.
fables.requirements: Survive a scenario at 1 HP or below without retreating.
fables.dateObtainedNote: Set automatically when a Dungeon Master awards this Fable.

fables.name: Quiet Between Storms
fables.description: Found calm in a moment that should have broken anyone else.
fables.story: In the eye of a scenario spinning out of every plan the party had, this character stopped, thought clearly, and turned it around.
fables.requirements: Resolve a scenario's critical turning point through a skill check rather than combat.
fables.dateObtainedNote: Set automatically when a Dungeon Master awards this Fable.

fables.name: A Name the Stream Remembers
fables.description: Marked as significant by something far larger than any single scenario.
fables.story: Whatever is watching from beyond the story took an interest, and it does not forget the names it watches.
fables.requirements: Complete a major arc as one of its central figures, DM discretion.
fables.dateObtainedNote: Set automatically when a Dungeon Master awards this Fable.

fables.name: The Giant Who Did Not Kneel
fables.description: Refused an ending that every sign said was inevitable.
fables.story: Where the story wrote a defeat, this character wrote something else instead, and the story had to accept it.
fables.requirements: Overturn a scenario's scripted defeat condition entirely, DM discretion, campaign-defining.
fables.dateObtainedNote: Set automatically when a Dungeon Master awards this Fable.
